title: lichen-node: rfc6554_route_crosses_two_relays_and_restores_packet fails at base (InvalidSourceRoute)
description: Pre-existing failure found while validating zt3c.7.4.1 on heft (my changes stashed, fails identically at HEAD): rust/lichen-node/src/rpl_stack/tests.rs:417 rfc6554_route_crosses_two_relays_and_restores_packet panics at :443 - add_rpl_source_route(&plain, &[relay_one, relay_two, destination], &mut wire) returns Err(InvalidSourceRoute). The test routes 02xx ygg addresses [relay_one, relay_two, destination] with a NO_NEXT (59) inner packet, 48 bytes total. Repro: cargo test -p lichen-node --lib rfc6554_route_crosses (workspace needs the oscore patch wiring from worker6 xyt6.1 / beads-worker-6 ebdf8c0f04 to build on Linux). Not caused by zt3c.7.4.1 (add_rpl_source_route untouched by it). Likely suspect: source==first-address prohibition or route shape validation rejecting a 3-address route with distinct source; investigate add_rpl_source_route (rust/lichen-node/src/stack.rs:769) validation against the test's inputs.
close_reason: Does not reproduce at HEAD: cargo test -p lichen-node --lib rfc6554_route_crosses passes; full lichen-node lib suite 293/293. Root cause: the bead's repro was taken on a stale heft checkout missing 7e872569e3 (fix committed 2026-08-30 21:41Z, ~8.5h BEFORE the bead was filed 2026-08-31 06:17Z). The fix changed the test's wrapped datagram from bare NO_NEXT+payload (genuinely chain-invalid; production RH3 admission survey rejecting it mirrors lichen/subsys/lichen/routing/router.c and was CORRECT) to a checksummed UDP datagram. Reviewer test-integrity verdict: FIXED-CORRECTLY - same two-relay exercise path, all RH3 field assertions retained, restore check now byte-exact over a checksummed header (slightly stronger), no skipped assertions. No code change from this worker; bead closed as already-fixed-by-7e872569e3. Note: heft checkout may need sync.
